work.title: The Life of King Henry the Fifth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 4, Scene 6
scene.title: SCENE VI. Another part of the field.

content.text: Alarum. Enter King Henry and his train, with prisoners.

lines.text: Well have we done, thrice valiant countrymen.
lines.plainText: Well have we done thrice valiant countrymen

lines.text: But all's not done; yet keep the French the field.
lines.plainText: But all's not done yet keep the French the field

lines.text: The Duke of York commends him to your Majesty.
lines.plainText: The Duke of York commends him to your Majesty

lines.text: Lives he, good uncle? Thrice within this hour
lines.plainText: Lives he good uncle Thrice within this hour

lines.text: I saw him down; thrice up again, and fighting.
lines.plainText: I saw him down thrice up again and fighting

lines.text: From helmet to the spur all blood he was.
lines.plainText: From helmet to the spur all blood he was

lines.text: In which array, brave soldier, doth he lie,
lines.plainText: In which array brave soldier doth he lie

lines.text: Larding the plain; and by his bloody side,
lines.plainText: Larding the plain and by his bloody side

lines.text: Yoke-fellow to his honour-owing wounds,
lines.plainText: Yokefellow to his honourowing wounds

lines.text: The noble Earl of Suffolk also lies.
lines.plainText: The noble Earl of Suffolk also lies

lines.text: Suffolk first died; and York, all haggled over,
lines.plainText: Suffolk first died and York all haggled over

lines.text: Comes to him, where in gore he lay insteeped,
lines.plainText: Comes to him where in gore he lay insteeped

lines.text: And takes him by the beard; kisses the gashes
lines.plainText: And takes him by the beard kisses the gashes

lines.text: That bloodily did yawn upon his face.
lines.plainText: That bloodily did yawn upon his face

lines.text: He cries aloud, "Tarry, my cousin Suffolk!
lines.plainText: He cries aloud Tarry my cousin Suffolk

lines.text: My soul shall thine keep company to heaven;
lines.plainText: My soul shall thine keep company to heaven

lines.text: Tarry, sweet soul, for mine, then fly abreast,
lines.plainText: Tarry sweet soul for mine then fly abreast

lines.text: As in this glorious and well-foughten field
lines.plainText: As in this glorious and wellfoughten field

lines.text: We kept together in our chivalry."
lines.plainText: We kept together in our chivalry

lines.text: Upon these words I came and cheer'd him up.
lines.plainText: Upon these words I came and cheer'd him up

lines.text: He smil'd me in the face, raught me his hand,
lines.plainText: He smil'd me in the face raught me his hand

lines.text: And, with a feeble gripe, says, "Dear my lord,
lines.plainText: And with a feeble gripe says Dear my lord

lines.text: Commend my service to my sovereign."
lines.plainText: Commend my service to my sovereign

lines.text: So did he turn and over Suffolk's neck
lines.plainText: So did he turn and over Suffolk's neck

lines.text: He threw his wounded arm and kiss'd his lips;
lines.plainText: He threw his wounded arm and kiss'd his lips

lines.text: And so espous'd to death, with blood he seal'd
lines.plainText: And so espous'd to death with blood he seal'd

lines.text: A testament of noble-ending love.
lines.plainText: A testament of nobleending love

lines.text: The pretty and sweet manner of it forc'd
lines.plainText: The pretty and sweet manner of it forc'd

lines.text: Those waters from me which I would have stopp'd;
lines.plainText: Those waters from me which I would have stopp'd

lines.text: But I had not so much of man in me,
lines.plainText: But I had not so much of man in me

lines.text: And all my mother came into mine eyes
lines.plainText: And all my mother came into mine eyes

lines.text: And gave me up to tears.
lines.plainText: And gave me up to tears

lines.text: I blame you not;
lines.plainText: I blame you not

lines.text: For, hearing this, I must perforce compound
lines.plainText: For hearing this I must perforce compound

lines.text: With mistful eyes, or they will issue too.
lines.plainText: With mistful eyes or they will issue too
